header.one_liner: ideaForge is an Indian UAV company whose NETRA family has documented Indian security-force use.

what_it_is.prose: ideaForge's NETRA family has documented homeland-security use. PIB reported CRPF holding NETRA micro-UAVs in 2015, while ideaForge's NETRA V4 Prime brochure documents the company's current micro-UAV product capabilities and defence/homeland-security pedigree.

faq.question: Is NETRA used by security forces?

faq.answer: Historical NETRA quantities should not be treated as current V4 fleet size.
